content.text: At 5, the most effective move is a slow transition rather than a cold switch: start with a consistent bedtime routine (bath, story, 2 songs - same every night), then spend a few nights on a mattress on his floor before moving gradually toward the door. Most kids this age respond well to a "brave chart" - a sticker for each night he starts in his own space, with a small reward after 5 or 7 nights. It usually takes 2-3 weeks of holding the line, and the hardest part is going back less and less when he calls out - not ignoring him, just shorter and calmer each time.
